title: الأعياد الرسمية في المغرب — الكتالوغ الكامل، 3 لغة (1956–2030)
description: Complete catalog of official public, governmental, school, bank, workday, Christian, and Hebrew holidays of Morocco (المغرب) — extracted from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation. المغرب/Al-Maghreb (Morocco). Kingdom of Morocco — independence from France/Spain 1956. Country code: MA. Categories: public. Multilingual names (3 languages: ar, en_US, fr). End-of-string `(estimated)/(observed)` parentheticals stripped from name columns and lifted into per-record `is_estimated`/`is_observed` boolean flags (per-language regex). No subdivisions — single national list.
